requirements: L01: UI confirmation follows the business transaction commit.
L05: failure is visible and retry remains possible.
Fast repeated taps and L-T04: the same action must not duplicate.
Keep edits on failure for retry.
Confirm records only after successful persistence.
Calendar backfill and existing factual dates remain supported.

defectsConfirmedBySource.defect: Detail archive discarded the boolean commit result and closed the sheet even on false.
Pause directly called a non-idempotent toggle with no immediate entry lock.
Calendar completion directly called a non-idempotent toggle with no immediate entry lock.
Rest confirmation could be opened again while a prior transaction still showed the old rest state.
Archived-list restore directly toggled archive state; repeated pending callbacks could rearchive it.
The first implementation blocked pending writes but could start an idle write from a cached callback after the detail sheet had been dismissed and a replacement route pushed before the next frame.

resultingBehavior: Detail writes first require their original modal route to remain current and acquire a live synchronous entry lock before any await. Calendar completion, pause, archive, rest confirmation and delete confirmation share it.
Archive/delete close the original detail route only after a true result and only if that captured route remains current and the state is mounted.
False keeps the detail and original facts with a visible, accessible error near the triggering action; unknown exceptions ask the user to inspect current state without asserting a rollback.
One inline live-region error is made visible after layout with ensureVisible; no obscured home-Scaffold Snackbar duplicates the message.
Cancelled confirmations return null without a save-error message. Rest/delete buttons are single use and verify their own dialog route is still current before popping.
Archived-list rows have state keyed by habit ID; restore/delete confirmation cannot share repeated pending callbacks.
Existing +1/+5 quick increments, quick-record undo, domain algorithms, ordinary detail navigation and normal detail dismissal retain their behavior.

cases: Archive, pause and calendar completion each receive two cached callbacks before the next frame: one repository write, no uncommitted state, expected persisted fact on controller reopen.

Archive returns false: original snapshot remains, detail stays, error is hit-testable and inside the real modal sheet; retry closes only after commit. Every field of the old-date entry's toJson and its note are preserved after failure and successful archive retry, including separate actual-controller reloads.
Late archive completes during sheet dismissal/new-route navigation: the replacement route stays open.
Calendar completion returns false: original facts remain and the error is hit-testable inside the visible sheet.
Archived-list restore fails, remains archived, exposes error and then retries with one write per attempt.
Rest entry and confirmation each receive two stale callbacks: one dialog, one committed exemption.
Rest/delete cancellation causes no writes or save errors.
After rest/delete dialog dismissal, its same-frame stale confirm callback neither writes nor closes the detail.
Archive, pause and completion cached callbacks invoked after idle sheet dismissal/replacement navigation before the next frame perform no repository write and leave the replacement route open.
